[font=Arial Black][color=#93c47d][size=5][line][/size][/color][/font][font=Arial Black][color=#674ea7][size=5]What it Does[/size][/color][/font][color=#674ea7] [/color]
It lets you put wine into a preserves jar and get 2 vinegar from it (i suggest using cheaper wine)

[line][color=#B45F06]
[font=Arial Black][color=#674ea7][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/font][/color]
it should be compatible with any mod as long as it doesn't make wine produce something different in a preserves jar.
[line]

[color=#FAC08F][font=Arial Black][size=5][color=#674ea7]Installation[/color]
[/size][/font][/color]install ProducerFrameworkMod to the mods folder
place [PFM] Vinegar into the mods folder
[line]

[font=Arial Black][color=#674ea7][size=5]Un-instillation[/size][/color][/font]
remove [PFM] Vinegar folder from mods the folder
[line]

[font=Arial Black][color=#674ea7][size=5]Bugs[/size][/color][/font]
